title.ar: الدوال والقيمة المطلقة ونظرية المعادلات التربيعية

body.en: Mastering the structural foundations of higher algebra: function domains, codomains, one-to-one conditions for invertibility, modulus equations \( |f(x)| = g(x) \), and precise quadratic discriminant criteria.

A function \( f \) has an inverse \( f^{-1} \) if and only if \( f \) is a one-to-one (injective) mapping across its given domain. For any \( y = f(x) \), \( f^{-1}(y) = x \). The domain of \( f^{-1} \) equals the range of \( f \), and the range of \( f^{-1} \) equals the domain of \( f \). Graphically, \( y = f^{-1}(x) \) is the reflection of \( y = f(x) \) in the line \( y = x \).

body.en:
Solve the equation \( |2x - 5| = 3x + 1 \).

Method 1 (Case Analysis):
Case 1: \( 2x - 5 = 3x + 1 \implies -x = 6 \implies x = -6 \).
Check validity: \( |-12 - 5| = 17 \), but \( 3(-6) + 1 = -17 \ne 17 \). Hence \( x = -6 \) is an extraneous solution because the RHS must be non-negative (\( 3x + 1 \ge 0 \implies x \ge -\frac{1}{3} \)).
Case 2: \( -(2x - 5) = 3x + 1 \implies -2x + 5 = 3x + 1 \implies 5x = 4 \implies x = \frac{4}{5} \).
Check: \( |2(0.8) - 5| = |-3.4| = 3.4 \); \( 3(0.8) + 1 = 3.4 \). Valid!

Final Answer: \( x = \frac{4}{5} \).

Find the values of \( k \) for which the line \( y = kx - 2 \) is a tangent to the curve \( y = x^2 + 2x + 7 \).

Solution:
Equate equations: \( x^2 + 2x + 7 = kx - 2 \implies x^2 + (2 - k)x + 9 = 0 \).
Since the line is a tangent, the intersection has exactly one real root, so the discriminant \( \Delta = b^2 - 4ac = 0 \):
\[ (2 - k)^2 - 4(1)(9) = 0 \implies (2 - k)^2 - 36 = 0 \]
\[ (2 - k)^2 = 36 \implies 2 - k = \pm 6 \]
\[ 2 - k = 6 \implies k = -4, \quad 2 - k = -6 \implies k = 8 \]
Answer: \( k = -4 \) or \( k = 8 \).

body.en:
Solve the quadratic equation \( x^2 - 13x + 36 = 0 \) and verify the sum and product of its roots.

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Factor into binomials: \( (x - 4)(x - 9) = 0 \implies x = 4 \text{ or } x = 9 \).
  2. Check Vieta's formulas: sum \( = 4 + 9 = \mathbf{13} \) and product \( = (4)(9) = \mathbf{36} \).
body.ar:
حل المعادلة التربيعية \( x^2 - 13x + 36 = 0 \) وتحقق من مجموع وحاصل ضرب الجذرين.

الحل بالتفصيل:
  1. التحليل إلى عوامل: \( (x - 4)(x - 9) = 0 \implies x = 4 \text{ أو } x = 9 \).
  2. المجموع \( = \mathbf{13} \) وحاصل الضرب \( = \mathbf{36} \).

body.en:
Solve the quadratic equation \( x^2 - 10x + 25 = 0 \) and verify the sum and product of its roots.

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Factor into binomials: \( (x - 5)(x - 5) = 0 \implies x = 5 \text{ or } x = 5 \).
  2. Check Vieta's formulas: sum \( = 5 + 5 = \mathbf{10} \) and product \( = (5)(5) = \mathbf{25} \).

  1. التحليل إلى عوامل: \( (x - 5)(x - 5) = 0 \implies x = 5 \text{ أو } x = 5 \).

question.en: [Functions, Modulus & Quadratic Theory · Practice 1] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \), evaluate \( g(4) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 18 \).
question.ar: [Functions, Modulus & Quadratic Theory · تدريب 1] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \)، فأوجد \( g(4) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 18 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). Setting \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) gives \( 3t = 15 \implies t = \mathbf{5} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). وعندما \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{5} \).

question.en: [Functions, Modulus & Quadratic Theory · Practice 2] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 4t + 4 \), evaluate \( g(6) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 32 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 6 \): \( g(6) = 4(6) + 4 = \mathbf{28} \). Setting \( 4t + 4 = 32 \) gives \( 4t = 28 \implies t = \mathbf{7} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 6 \): \( g(6) = 4(6) + 4 = \mathbf{28} \). وعندما \( 4t + 4 = 32 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{7} \).
